description.fun: A sweet-smelling Pokémon that hides in a peach-shaped shell and rolls poisonous mochi. Whoever eats one has their deepest desires drawn out and falls under its control, which is how it bound the Loyal Three to its will. Its story mirrors the folktale of Momotarō, the boy born from a peach who fought ogres with a dog, a monkey and a pheasant, with heroes and villains swapped. It fakes weakness by weeping like a baby.
description.guide: A Poison and Ghost-type Mythical Pokémon introduced in The Indigo Disk, the leader of the Loyal Three. It feeds people and Pokémon toxic mochi that bring them under its control. Its story mirrors the folktale of Momotarō, with heroes and villains reversed.
description.tagline: A peach-shelled schemer whose poisoned mochi bind you to its will
